beats.text: East Timor gets 99.6 percent of its electricity from oil. In Nigeria, it is 0.04 percent.
East Timor has 142 times the share of electricity from oil that the USA has.
The Gambia gets 98.4 percent from oil, and Chad gets 97.7 percent.
Meanwhile, China runs on just 0.1 percent oil for electricity, and India gets 0.7 percent.
Georgia, Latvia, Nepal, and Zimbabwe get 0 percent of their electricity from oil.
What is the primary source of electricity in your country?
